integrity: An analytic proof establishes the all-dimensional sharp strict inequality and degenerating sharpness. Standalone finite numerical checks supplement but do not prove the theorem. No independent validation or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: For Euclidean squared-distance moments and full-dimensional simplices, with Hausdorff-uniform surface sampling. Does not cover first moments or arbitrary convex bodies. The infimum is approached but never attained. Historical priority remains provisional; independent assessment is absent.
title: Sharp squared-chord boundary/interior ratio for Euclidean simplices and its dimension-four reversal
